Title: Public Preview: Databricks One in Azure Databricks

Body.Content:
Databricks One in Azure Databricks delivers a unified, simplified experience that brings together data engineering, analytics, and AI development in a single, governed platform. By integrating collaborative workflows, enterprise-grade governance, and performance-optimized infrastructure, Databricks One empowers you to move from data to insights to innovation, faster and more securely. As part of the broader Azure ecosystem, Databricks One gives you a seamless, end-to-end solution that scales with evolving needs, from data ingestion to AI-powered applications. Databricks One represents more than a product enhancement—it serves as a strategic catalyst for organizations aiming to develop AI solutions responsibly. It strengthens the shared vision of Microsoft and Databricks to democratize data and AI by reducing complexity and silos across the modern data stack.  

Learn more.
